name: Disable Enhance Pointer Precision
description: Disables mouse acceleration to make cursor movement more direct and consistent, which many users and gamers prefer for better control.

description_i18n.en: Disables mouse acceleration to make cursor movement more direct and consistent, which many users and gamers prefer for better control.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Mausbeschleunigung für eine direktere und konsistentere Cursorbewegung, was viele Benutzer und Gamer für bessere Kontrolle bevorzugen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'accélération de la souris pour rendre le mouvement du curseur plus direct et cohérent, ce que beaucoup d'utilisateurs et joueurs préfèrent pour un meilleur contrôle.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies registry values MouseSpeed, MouseThreshold1, and MouseThreshold2 under HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse to set speed to 0 and thresholds to 0
